plugin.name: Charamel Embed (VuppetMaster JS-API)
plugin.description: Virtual character driven via the embedded VuppetMaster JavaScript API (vm.speak). Distinct from charamel-ws, which drives a Charamel-hosted page via the timeline-JSON protocol.

required.name: port
required.description: HTTP + WebSocket port serving the character page

required.name: sceneflowVar
required.description: SceneFlow variable set true when the character page connects (WebSocket handshake; fires before the 3D model has loaded)

required.name: characterReady
required.description: SceneFlow variable set true when the character model is fully loaded and audio is unlocked (the real 'ready to interact' signal)

required.name: characterSpeaking
required.description: SceneFlow variable true while the character is speaking

required.name: sceneflowTurnUtteranceVar
required.description: SceneFlow variable receiving the current utterance text

optional.name: certificate
optional.description: Path to SSL certificate (reserved; plain WS used when absent)

optional.name: browser
optional.description: Browser to open: empty = OS default, 'chrome' = Google Chrome, other = path to executable

pluginSpecific.name: engineUrl
pluginSpecific.description: URL of the VuppetMaster engine bundle

pluginSpecific.name: autostart_browser
pluginSpecific.description: Auto-open the character page in a browser on plugin launch

pluginSpecific.name: browser_fullscreen
pluginSpecific.description: Start browser in full-screen mode (Chrome only)

commands.name: background
commands.summary: Set the page backdrop shown behind the transparent avatar
commands.description: Usable from a SceneFlow PlayAction ([Xenia background color='#1a2a6c']) or inline scene marker. Any CSS color string.

params.name: color
params.description: CSS color, e.g. '#1a2a6c' or 'black'

commands.name: emotion
commands.summary: Play a named emotion on the avatar (vm.setEmotion)
commands.description: Generic form: [Xenia emotion type='happy' intensity='0.8' hold='1500']. Convenience aliases exist for each type so [Xenia happy] also works. Types: happy, sad, angry, tear, disgust, surprise, smile, excited, fear, bored, relaxed.

params.name: type
params.description: Emotion type (IEmotionType): happy | sad | angry | tear | disgust | surprise | smile | excited | fear | bored | relaxed

params.name: intensity
params.description: Peak amplitude 0..1 (default 1)

params.name: attack
params.description: Fade-in ms (default 500)

params.name: hold
params.description: Sustain ms; omit for a sustained pose held until changed/cleared

params.name: decay
params.description: Fade-out ms (default 500)

commands.name: clearemotion
commands.summary: Release the current emotion back to the idle base mood

commands.name: bone
commands.summary: Rotate a skeleton bone with an attack/hold/decay envelope (vm.animateBone)
commands.description: Generic form: [Xenia bone name='Head' y='-12' attack='150' hold='300' decay='250']. Angles are DEGREES (converted to the engine's radians by vm-adapter.js) applied as an Euler XYZ rotation. On the current Head rig the axes are x = yaw (turn/shake), y = pitch (nod; NEGATIVE drops the chin), z = roll (tilt) - verified against the live rig, which does not follow the usual pitch/yaw/roll ordering. Only 'Head' is exposed by the current VuppetMaster rig. Omitting hold strikes a SUSTAINED pose held until changed - release it by re-issuing the command at the neutral angle with an explicit hold, e.g. [Xenia bone name='Head' y='0' hold='0']. For plain nodding prefer the 'nod' command.

params.name: name
params.description: Bone name on the skeleton, case-insensitive (default 'Head'). Unknown names are warned about in the browser console and otherwise ignored by the engine.

params.name: x
params.description: Yaw in degrees - the turn/shake axis (default 0)

params.name: y
params.description: Pitch in degrees - the nod axis; NEGATIVE drops the chin (default 0)

params.name: z
params.description: Roll in degrees - the head-tilt axis (default 0)

params.name: attack
params.description: Fade-in ms (default 500)

params.name: hold
params.description: Sustain ms; omit for a sustained pose held until changed

params.name: decay
params.description: Fade-out ms back to the resting pose (default 500)

params.name: additive
params.description: true (default) layers the rotation on top of the running idle animation; false replaces the bone's pose outright

commands.name: nod
commands.summary: Procedural head nod - repeated down-and-back pitch excursions
commands.description: Convenience form built on vm.animateBone: [Xenia nod], [Xenia nod repeats='3' amplitude='8' period='320']. Each cycle pitches the head by amplitude degrees and rocks back, so the head always returns to its resting pose. Layered additively over the idle animation.

params.name: amplitude
params.description: Full peak-to-peak excursion in degrees; the head swings +/-amplitude/2 around the neutral pose, so 12 means 6 down then 6 up (default 12)

params.name: repeats
params.description: Number of nod cycles (default 2)

params.name: period
params.description: Duration of one down-and-back cycle in ms (default 400)

params.name: name
params.description: Bone to nod (default 'Head')

commands.name: shake
commands.summary: Procedural head shake - repeated side-to-side yaw excursions
commands.description: Convenience form built on vm.animateBone, the 'no' counterpart to 'nod': [Xenia shake], [Xenia shake repeats='3' amplitude='20' period='320']. Swings on the yaw (turn) axis, centred on the neutral pose, and always ends back at rest. Layered additively over the idle animation.

params.name: amplitude
params.description: Full peak-to-peak excursion in degrees; the head swings +/-amplitude/2 around the neutral pose, so 16 means 8 to one side then 8 to the other (default 16)

params.name: repeats
params.description: Number of shake cycles (default 2)

params.name: period
params.description: Duration of one side-to-side cycle in ms (default 400)

params.name: name
params.description: Bone to shake (default 'Head')
